name: const unsafe fn write < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: Overwriting the contents of `dst` without dropping the old value is permitted for safety, even if this leaks allocations or resources, provided `dst` is valid for writing `size_of::<T>()` bytes and aligned to `align_of::<T>()`.
api: const unsafe fn write < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
